description: Real enveloped subagent run (447 frames, both {rpc} and {evt:{channel:"subagents:*"}} planes folded). Reality-check for the subagent shape family.
note: WIRE-WIDTH WARNING (2026-11-18, from scenario 016's capture): the `subagents:*` / `plan:snapshot` {evt} channels this scenario feeds are NOT what the shipped extension sends. Its only panel producers are extension/src/routing.ts:120 and session/relay_lifecycle.ts:246, and both emit `{evt:{channel:"panel", data:{type:"panel_update", key:"subagents"|"plan", title, icon, data:{items}}}}` — coalesced full snapshots, one per source per 60 ms tick. The app handles that form in its UI layer (AppModel+Inbound.swift:569 re-routes the inner panel_update as a stock ServerMessage); core's EnvelopeReducer — which is what the conformance harness runs — and the web client both key on the granular channels, so on the wire they see nothing. 002 pins the code path, not the transport; 016 pins the transport and shows both folds producing an EMPTY panel from it. Choosing between them (unwrap in core + client, or emit the granular channels) is an open decision.
